name: portfolio
description: Portfolio handoff and quality gate scaffolding.

scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:visual && npm run smoke:a11y && npm run smoke:token-semantic && npm run smoke:perf
scripts.verify:slice: npm run smoke:visual && npm run smoke:a11y && npm run smoke:token-semantic && npm run smoke:live
scripts.lint:quality: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:html
scripts.smoke:visual: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/home.visual.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:a11y: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/home.a11y.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:token-semantic: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/home.token-semantic.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:hero: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/home.hero-reveal.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:footer: npm run build && playwright test tests/smoke/home.footer-reveal.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:structure: npm run build && node scripts/quality/check-html-structure.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-css-consistency.mjs
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint:quality && npm run smoke:structure && npm run smoke:a11y
